about_subtitle: History and values of «ABŞERONİK» sports club
history_p1: «ABŞERONİK» sports club was founded in 2022 in the Absheron region of Azerbaijan. Initially, our club started with basketball only, aiming to develop professional basketball in the region.
history_p2: In a short period of time, our club managed to take a place among the strongest teams in national competitions by displaying a dynamic and spectactular game. We are proud of our team and continuously work to improve the quality of play.
history_p3: Starting this year, our club has expanded to launch football activities as well — football training sessions are now taking place in our club! «ABŞERONİK» is not just a sports club, it is a sports development center in Azerbaijan where future stars are raised.
val_1_desc: We strive for the highest standards in everything we do
val_2_desc: We set ambitious goals and achieve them
val_3_desc: Together we are stronger – this is our core principle
val_4_desc: We continuously improve and develop basketball and football in the region
mission_text: To develop basketball and football in Azerbaijan, nurture talented athletes, and bring the joy of victory to fans through exciting professional play. We strive to set an example for the young generation and inspire youth to engage in sports.
